launches.title: Naive - Hire Autonomous Employees that actually run your company.
launches.tagline: Describe your business. Naive runs it.
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/qYzbzuBmqDo>\
\
Naïve is an autonomous company runtime. \
\
You describe your business — or connect your existing one — and Naïve deploys AI employees that actually execute.

1. Our employees have their own identity. Own bank account, own email, own credentials, own compute. 
2. They sign up for tools, pay for services, deploy apps, and file documents as themselves. No human in the loop.
3. They  learn recursively. Every output, every result gets stored. They extract patterns about YOUR business and compound performance week over week.

**New companies** — describe what you want, Naïve builds and runs it. \
\
**Existing companies** — one-click connect your stack (CRM, codebase, Shopify, Notion, whatever), Naïve employees plug in day one.\
\

\
**Intro**\
\
Relixir ([relixir.ai](http://relixir.ai)) is building the AI GEO - Generative Engine Optimization - platform to help teams rank higher & sell more on ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.\
\
AI search is taking over, and _all decision makers_ are now using AI assistants to make purchase decisions.

However, getting mentioned by AI search is a new black box for teams who are struggling to navigate/maximize their recommendation rate.\
\
**How it works**

With Relixir, companies can now:

1. Gain instant visibility into their AI search engine analytics
2. Identify competitor recommendations, blind spots, and information gaps
3. Auto-publish GEO-optimized content to flip rankings in their favor

**Founders**\
\
Founders [Sean Dorje](https://linkedin.com/in/seandorje) and [Dennis Zax](https://linkedin.com/in/dennis-zax-704165201) are _Berkeley dropouts_ who built the first internal GEO system at their previous company to rank #1 in 200+ searches by auto-producing a high-quality content farm.\
\
**Mission**\
\
Relixir’s mission is to transform content marketing by using AI search engines to diagnose what truly resonates with customers, moving beyond keyword gaming to create authentic content that evolves with your brand & captures your product's genuine voice.\
\
**Join us**

Join Relixir and get to the top of AI search today. Reach out: [sean@relixir.ai](mailto:sean@relixir.ai)
